relations.label: is interested in
relations.description: Holder-specific interest; proficiency is independent.

relations.label: prefers
relations.description: A preference may be overridden by obligation or circumstance.

relations.label: enjoys
relations.description: Enjoyment is not ownership, skill or constant willingness.

relations.label: dislikes
relations.description: Disliking an activity does not prevent doing it for someone.

relations.label: has habit
relations.description: An authored recurring pattern; no automatic action selection.

relations.label: uses coping strategy
relations.description: A pattern observed in this example, not a diagnosis.

relations.label: sets boundary
relations.description: A personal boundary with a holder and optional context.

relations.label: can respect boundary
relations.description: Whether it respects the actual person's limit depends on context.

relations.label: can cross boundary
relations.description: A plausible boundary conflict, not a universal offense flag.

relations.label: experiences bodily state
relations.description: Private bodily experience; another person's awareness is not implied.

relations.label: interprets situation as
relations.description: Use context for the particular situation/event interpreted.

relations.label: can be an appraisal of
relations.description: The same occurrence can receive incompatible appraisals.

relations.label: expects
relations.description: An expectation need not have been communicated or promised.

relations.label: anticipates something about
relations.description: Identifies the subject without endorsing the prediction.

relations.label: can confirm expectation
relations.description: A possible interpretation of confirming evidence.

relations.label: can disappoint expectation
relations.description: Disappointment does not establish wrongdoing.

relations.label: faces constraint
relations.description: An authored practical limitation, not an unwillingness or character flaw.

relations.label: can constrain
relations.description: Limits available routes; alternatives may remain.

relations.label: can be accommodated by
relations.description: A practical adjustment rather than a compulsory emotional lesson.

relations.label: creates occasion for
relations.description: A gathering opportunity, not an enforced story beat.

relations.label: may remind a holder of
relations.description: Only applies to people whose history supplies the association.

relations.label: shares interest with
relations.description: qualifiers.object names the interest. Shared taste does not guarantee friendship.

relations.label: competes for
relations.description: Competition can be friendly, unrecognized or unfair.

relations.label: is invited to
relations.description: An invitation does not imply acceptance, access forever or knowledge of all participants.

relations.label: tries to avoid
relations.description: Intended avoidance can conflict with routes, obligations or affection.

relations.label: wants contact with
relations.description: The target need not reciprocate or know about the wish.

relations.label: can use channel
relations.description: A potential transmission route, not a broadcast to everyone.

relations.label: may reach audience
relations.description: Reach depends on presence, access and attention.

relations.label: is limited by
relations.description: Documents delay, privacy or access limitations.

relations.label: can feature
relations.description: A recurring interaction can be interrupted or changed.

relations.label: participates in pattern
relations.description: Context and other participants should be recorded explicitly.

relations.label: sees self as
relations.description: Private self-concept, not an objective identity verdict.

relations.label: presents self as
relations.description: An intended presentation; other people may read it differently.

relations.label: aspires to
relations.description: A hoped-for future, not a scheduled transformation.

relations.label: can challenge self-image
relations.description: People can revise, defend or complicate their self-understanding.

relations.label: undergoes transition
relations.description: A change in this fictional person's circumstances.

relations.label: can change role
relations.description: A possible role change, never a forced age-based promotion.

relations.label: can change routine
relations.description: A possible schedule reorganization.

relations.label: may draw someone toward
relations.description: Candidate influence only. The atlas does not select actions.

relations.label: can amplify response
relations.description: A design hypothesis, not a universal psychological rule.

relations.label: can carry a cost of
relations.description: A tradeoff to consider alongside possible benefits.

relations.label: can discuss
relations.description: The speaker still needs access to the subject information.

relations.label: wants to preserve
relations.description: A cherished recollection or practice can contain mixed feelings.

relations.label: would rather forget
relations.description: A wish does not delete an event or another person's memory.

relations.label: publicly supports
relations.description: An observable act can differ from private feelings.

relations.label: receives credit for
relations.description: Recognition is separate from who contributed or deserved it.

relations.label: bears cost
relations.description: Someone not responsible for an incident can still bear its cost.
